entries.question: How do I cancel an order?
entries.answer: You can cancel an order free of charge until it ships: open My Orders, select the order and click Cancel order. Once an order has shipped it cannot be cancelled; please return it instead (see our returns policy).

entries.question: Can I change items or the size in my order?
entries.answer: Orders can be changed only before they ship. Open My Orders, select the order and click Edit order to change items, sizes or quantities. If the order has already shipped, place a new order and return the unwanted item.

entries.question: How do I track my order?
entries.answer: When your order ships we email you a tracking number. You can also see the current status under My Orders. Orders usually ship within 2 business days of purchase.

entries.question: What are your delivery options and how long does delivery take?
entries.answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders over $50 (otherwise $4.99). Express delivery takes 1-2 business days and costs $12.99. Delivery times start when the order ships.

entries.question: Which countries do you deliver to?
entries.answer: We currently deliver to the United States and Canada only. Delivery to Canada takes 5-8 business days.

entries.question: How do I change my shipping address?
entries.answer: You can change the address for future orders under Account > Addresses. For an order that has not shipped yet, edit the address in My Orders. Once an order has shipped, the address can no longer be changed.

entries.question: What is your return and refund policy?
entries.answer: You can return unused items in their original packaging within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Opened electronics can be returned within 30 days but a 15% restocking fee applies. Start a return from My Orders.

entries.question: When will I receive my refund?
entries.answer: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5 business days after we receive and inspect your return. Your bank may need a further 3-5 business days to show it.

entries.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
entries.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay. We do not accept cash on delivery or bank transfers.

entries.question: My payment failed or I was charged incorrectly. What should I do?
entries.answer: If a payment fails, check your card details and try again or use another payment method. If you see a charge you do not recognise or a duplicate charge, contact our support team with your order number; the payments team investigates within 2 business days.

entries.question: How do I get an invoice for my order?
entries.answer: Invoices are available as PDF downloads under My Orders > Invoice once the order has shipped. We cannot change the billing name on an invoice after it is issued.

entries.question: How do I reset my password or delete my account?
entries.answer: To reset your password, click Forgot password on the login page and follow the emailed link (valid for 1 hour). To delete your account, go to Account > Privacy > Delete account; deletion is permanent and removes your order history.

entries.question: How can I contact a human agent?
entries.answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 9:00-17:00 Eastern Time, by live chat on our website or by replying to this email. We do not offer phone support.

entries.question: Is there a fee for cancelling my subscription plan early?
entries.answer: Northwind Plus can be cancelled at any time with no cancellation fee. Your benefits stay active until the end of the current billing month; we do not refund partial months.

entries.question: How do I unsubscribe from marketing emails?
entries.answer: Click Unsubscribe at the bottom of any marketing email, or turn off newsletters under Account > Notifications. Order and delivery emails cannot be turned off.
